provenance.notes: R6-03.REING1 (zone G row G-5): the twenty-four prism tiles of the v2 tileset in the exact content order — solid, floor, ceiling, wall-left, wall-right, the seven slope forms, brick, cube, tissue, crystal, crystal-hot, facet-glow, shard-floor — taken as a 6x4 full-bleed contact grid of 192-px cells from the GEN-1 gen3 sheet, whose sidecar names all twenty-four cells in that same reading order. Numeric probes: all 24 cell hashes distinct, zero key background anywhere (the sheet is an opaque painted panel, key mode none), no guide lines at cell boundaries. clip-to-mask keeps the tileset's collision masks the truth (decision W5-11); facet-glow is an empty decoration and keeps its art whole.
